support.q1: I'm not receiving the verification code.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Rekalp account
deleteAccount.withoutAppBody: Email us from your account's email address with the subject "Delete account". Timeframe: up to 30 days.
deleteAccount.mailtoButton: Email us to delete my account
deleteAccount.mailtoBody: Hi, I want to delete my Rekalp account associated with this email address.%0D%0A%0D%0AThanks.
deleteAccount.dataDeleted: Deleted: your real name, your email (replaced with an anonymous address), and all your active sessions are revoked.
deleteAccount.dataKept: Kept anonymously: your workouts, custom exercises, records, and measurements — no longer linked to your identity. Your birth year is truncated to January 1st of the same year; your gender is kept unchanged. Free-text notes on your workouts, exercises, and records are cleared, since that's the one place you might have written something identifiable.
deleteAccount.subscriptionWarningBody: Deleting your account does not cancel your Rekalp Pro subscription. Cancel it first from your App Store or Google Play account settings — deleting the account does not stop billing.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Rekalp ("the App") is operated by BRT Digital Media ("we," "us"). This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and where it's stored.
privacy.s2Title: 2. What data we process, by source
privacy.s2Web: Website: your email and the waitlist form data, the source you arrived from, and technical browsing data. We don't use unnecessary cookies.
privacy.s2AppAccount: App account: email, name, birth year, gender, language, and preferences.
privacy.s2AppTraining: Training data: your routines, custom exercises, personal records, and body measurements.
privacy.s2AppDevice: Device and session data, to keep your account secure and in sync.
privacy.s2AppAds: Advertising, on the free tier, via Google Mobile Ads, which may use device identifiers.
privacy.s2AppImages: Images you upload, stored via Cloudinary.
privacy.s3Body: We process your data to provide the service (basis: contract performance), to notify you about the launch if you join the waitlist (basis: your consent), and to improve the app securely (basis: legitimate interest).
privacy.s4Body: We share data with the providers that help us run the service: our hosting provider, Amplitude (analytics), Google AdMob (advertising), Cloudinary (images), our email provider, and Apple App Store / Google Play (to manage subscription payments). We never sell your data to anyone.
privacy.s5Body: Some of our providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, always with the legal safeguards required (such as the EU's standard contractual clauses).
privacy.s6Body: We keep your data while you have an active account. If you delete your account, identifiable personal data is anonymized — see the delete account page for details.
privacy.s7Body: You can access, correct, delete, object to, restrict, request portability of, and withdraw consent for your data at any time by writing to the contact address below, or by filing a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).
privacy.s8Body: Some body measurements and training data could be considered health-related data. We handle it with the same care as any other personal data, under your consent when using the app.
privacy.s9Body: Rekalp is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them.
privacy.s10Body: On the free tier we show ads via Google Mobile Ads. Where required, consent is requested through each platform's standard mechanisms (such as Google's EU consent form, or Apple's tracking notice).
privacy.s11Body: This website doesn't use any cookies beyond what's strictly necessary. There's no cookie banner because none is needed.
privacy.s12Body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the effective date.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy? Write to us.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Rekalp ("the App"), operated by BRT Digital Media ("we," "us"). By creating an account or using the App, you agree to these terms.
terms.s1Body: Rekalp helps you plan, log, and track gym workouts: an exercise catalog, training history, personal records, body measurements, and stats.
terms.s2Body: Rekalp uses a passwordless login: you sign in with your email and a one-time code. You're responsible for providing accurate account information and for keeping your device and session secure. You must be old enough to legally consent to these terms in your country of residence.
terms.s3Body: Rekalp is free, with an optional Rekalp Pro subscription (removes ads and allows more devices signed in at once). Subscriptions are billed through the Apple App Store or Google Play, depending on your device.
terms.s3Item1: Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
terms.s3Item2: Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID or Google Play account settings, not in the App.
terms.s3Item3: Uninstalling the App does not cancel an active subscription.
terms.s3Item4: Prices are shown before purchase and may vary by region and currency.
terms.s4Body: You keep ownership of the training data, notes, and custom exercises you create in the App. By using the App, you grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to store, process, and use that content to operate, maintain, and improve the App, including developing new features.
terms.s5Body: You agree not to misuse the App, including attempting unauthorized access to our systems, interfering with other users, or using the App for any unlawful purpose.
terms.healthWarningBody: Rekalp is a training-log tool, not a medical device or a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a physician before starting any new exercise program, especially if you have an existing health condition. BMI and estimated 1RM are informational only, not a diagnosis.
terms.s6Body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your own account at any time from within the App (Profile → Danger Zone) or from the website.
terms.s7Body: The App is provided "as is," without warranties of any kind, including that it will be uninterrupted or error-free. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental damages, or personal injury arising from your use of the App or exercises performed using it.
terms.s8Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continuing to use the App after a change means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s9Body: These terms are governed by the laws of Spain, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
